snip.t: Oesophageal atresia (OA) is a congenital interruption of the continuity of the oesophagus, and is very often associated with a tracheo-oesophageal fistula (TOF), a connection between the oesophagus and the trachea.

Signs that a tumour is unresectable: invasion of the trachea, bronchus or aorta, a tracheo-oesophageal fistula, vocal cord paralysis (hoarseness), tumour longer than about 10 cm, angulation of the oesophageal axis, distant metastases, and poor general condition.
